module_reference_review.stock_open_close_pair: richtap_file_open calls try_module_get at 0010ea44; richtap_file_release calls module_put at 0010ea8c.
module_reference_review.candidate_pair: richtap_file_open preserves try_module_get and drops it if the lifetime open fails; richtap_file_release drops the explicit pin after releasing its sidecar reference.
module_reference_review.vfs_fops_owner: Candidate left_fops.owner is THIS_MODULE. Target misc_open obtains that owner reference through fops_get; target __fput invokes release then fops_put, balancing the separate VFS pin.
module_reference_review.vma_file_reference: Target mmap_region stores get_file(file) in vma->vm_file; VMA teardown calls fput. This retains the fops.owner pin while vm_ops can execute; the separate sidecar VMA ref retains lifetime/FIFO-page state.
module_reference_review.misc_open_vs_remove: Target misc_open holds misc_mtx through the open callback. Remove releases haptic_lifetime_registry_lock before misc_deregister takes that mutex, so these paths do not hold the locks in opposite order.
module_reference_review.disposition: No unmatched explicit or VFS module reference identified by static review. misc_deregister and active-operation drain still gate state teardown.

misc_fops_state_routing.read: Stock richtap_read returns 0 without dereferencing struct file; candidate behavior is unchanged.
misc_fops_state_routing.write: Stock richtap_write returns count without dereferencing struct file; candidate behavior is unchanged.
misc_fops_state_routing.unlocked_ioctl: Lifetime wrapper enters the sidecar operation, passes a proxy whose private_data is raw haptic state to the stock-exact ioctl, then exits the operation.
misc_fops_state_routing.mmap: Candidate wrapper resolves state through the sidecar and attaches a VMA reference on successful remap; target MM retains the file itself for the VMA lifetime.
misc_fops_state_routing.disposition: Every registered Richtap fops slot was accounted for; no reviewed path interprets the sidecar pointer as raw haptic state.

lock_order_review.probe_and_remove: Both acquire haptic_lifecycle_transition_lock before haptic_lifetime_registry_lock; file operations do not acquire the transition lock.
lock_order_review.irq_and_stop_worker: Both acquire haptic_irq_stop_lock before entering stock IRQ code or taking the stop-work state mutex. Stock irq_config registers irq_handle as the threaded handler (primary=NULL), so the wrapper mutex is used in thread context.
lock_order_review.remove_drain: Remove does not hold haptic_irq_stop_lock while devm_free_irq synchronizes the threaded handler; shutdown gate is set first, IRQ is freed before work cancellation, and the transition lock is released on both the NULL-state early return and normal exit.
lock_order_review.static_review_result: No reverse lock order or unmatched transition unlock was identified in this review; runtime lockdep/stress remains unverified.

static_review_disposition: No unmatched enqueue identified for active work items. The +0x628 TikTap item is initialized with tiktap_work_routine, but the full decompilation/reference scan and direct-call inventory show no in-module enqueue path; ioctl 0x5213 is print-only. Remove keeps a defensive cancellation, and out-of-module scheduling remains outside this evidence.
